title: Clause 5 - Leadership
description: Working paper template for ISO/IEC 42001 Clause 5: leadership, AI policy, organizational roles.

sections.title: Leadership and commitment (5.1)
prompts: Identify evidence of top-management commitment to the AIMS.
Verify accountability for AI outcomes is assigned.
Check resourcing of the AIMS is documented.

sections.title: AI policy (5.2)
prompts: Confirm the AI policy is documented, approved, and communicated.
Verify the policy references trustworthy AI principles (fairness, accountability, transparency).
Check the policy is reviewed at defined intervals.

sections.title: Roles, responsibilities, authorities (5.3)
prompts: Map AIMS-related roles to named individuals.
Verify the AI ethics / governance committee has charter, members, cadence.

checklists.text: AI policy approved and signed by top management.
AI policy is communicated to the workforce.
AI accountability is assigned at executive level.
AI governance committee charter is current.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Walk us through how the AI policy was developed and approved.
How does top management demonstrate commitment to the AIMS in practice?
Who is accountable for AI risk at the executive level?
